name: search_entities
description: Find existing entities of the project by name (rico:name, rdfs:label, dcterms:title, foaf:name). Case- and accent-insensitive, tolerant of small spelling differences. Returns IRI, name, types, and whether each entity is internal (editable) or comes from an external data source (read-only). Use it before writing any query that refers to specific entities.

text.description: The name, or part of it, as the user wrote it.

type.description: Class IRI or CURIE to restrict the search (subclasses included), or an empty string for any type.

name: describe_entity
description: All the properties and values of one entity, with the source of each value (internal, or the external data source it comes from). Shows which properties this entity actually uses.

name: run_select
description: Run a read-only SPARQL SELECT query on the project and get the first rows (LIMIT 50 added when absent, 10-second limit). For lookups the other tools cannot express.

query.description: A SPARQL SELECT query, with its PREFIX declarations.

name: search_ontology
description: Search the RiC-O ontology (the only ontology described to you): labels in every language RiC-O provides, definitions and scope notes. Returns matching classes and properties with domain, range, inverse and definition.

text.description: Words describing the notion, e.g. "gender", "birth date", "recorded by".

name: find_usage
description: How this project's data records something: for a property IRI/CURIE, or a word (matched against the property names used in the data and against RiC-O), the number of entities using it per type, the kind of value, and the recurring values with their IRIs. Use it to reuse the project's existing encodings and vocabulary entities.

text_or_property.description: A property IRI or CURIE, or a word such as "gender".

type.description: Class IRI or CURIE of the subjects, or an empty string for every type.

name: search_history
description: More examples from this project's history of questions and the queries actually run for them, matching a text.

text.description: Words of the expression you want examples for.
